# Synthetic fixtures

Reproducible, ML-shaped data from [Rubix ML][rubix]'s dataset generators. Uniform noise — what
`benchmarks/` used before — exercises no realistic distribution, aspect ratio, or chain of
operations. These do.

Generated **once**, committed, and never regenerated by CI.

| fixture | shape | generator | drives |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `blob-100x4` | 100 x 4 | `Blob` | parity, small-n edges |
| `circle-500x2` | 500 x 2 | `Circle` | parity, small-n edges |
| `halfmoon-500x2` | 500 x 2 | `HalfMoon` | parity, small-n edges |
| `swissroll-1000x3` | 1000 x 3 | `SwissRoll` | parity, distance matrices |
| `blob-1000x8` | 1000 x 8 | `Blob` | benchmarks |
| `hyperplane-2000x12` | 2000 x 12 | `Hyperplane` | benchmarks, least-squares gradient |
| `agglomerate-5000x16` | 5000 x 16 | `Agglomerate` | benchmarks, large-m reductions |

The first four are the **parity** set (`Loader::PARITY`). Only they get full-fidelity transcripts:
a 5000x5000 result is 25 million elements, which no transcript can hold verbatim.

## Regenerating

`rubix/ml` is deliberately **not** a dependency of this package — it requires php >= 8.3 while
`composer.json` declares >= 8.1, so adding it would break the 8.1 and 8.2 CI legs. Generate from a
throwaway sandbox instead:

```sh
docker exec zephir-8.3 bash -lc '
  rm -rf /fixgen && mkdir -p /fixgen && cd /fixgen &&
  composer init -q -n --name=tmp/fixgen &&
  composer require -q rubix/ml &&
  cp /tensor-ext/tools/generate-fixtures.php . &&
  php -n -d serialize_precision=-1 -d memory_limit=2G generate-fixtures.php /tmp/fx'
docker cp zephir-8.3:/tmp/fx/. tests/fixtures/synthetic/
```

Then `vendor/bin/phpunit --filter FixtureLoaderTest` — it compares every file against the
`sha256` recorded in `MANIFEST.json`.

## Reproducibility

The generators draw from the **global** PRNG, so `generate-fixtures.php` calls `mt_srand(SEED)`
and `srand(SEED)` before each one. Verified byte-identical across consecutive runs.

- `SEED` = `20260921`
- `rubix/ml` = `2.6.0`
- PHP = `8.3.31` (container `zephir-8.3`)
- `serialize_precision` = `-1` — **required**. The generator asserts a lossless JSON round-trip
  and exits non-zero rather than commit a lossy fixture.

The four parity fixtures are pretty-printed for readable diffs; the three large ones are not
(`agglomerate-5000x16` alone would cost ~10 MB otherwise).

[rubix]: https://rubixml.github.io/ML/latest/extracting-data.html#synthetic-datasets
